speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I understand you're experiencing fever and abdominal tenderness after giving birth; can you tell me exactly when your delivery occurred and when the fever started? Also, have you experienced any foul-smelling vaginal discharge or chills?

speaker: Patient
text: 24-year-old woman. The patient is in the postpartum period after delivering an 11 pound boy vaginally at 40 weeks gestation. She experienced a prolonged course during labor. She reports increased frequency of urination and uterine tenderness. She also mentions a decrease in bowel sounds.

speaker: Doctor
text:
